findings.title: Connector tick clipped by overflow: hidden on Styled.Card
findings.spec_requirement: The card has a connector tick below it (a 4px-wide, 24px-tall divider line, matching the feed connector pattern in Styled.Event ::after pseudo-element at JobApplicationActivity.tsx lines 671-681). Use the same width (4px), color (t.dark ? t.color.gray[800] : t.color.gray[200]), and positioning.
findings.evidence: Styled.Card has overflow: hidden applied (PlatoOverviewCallout.tsx line 97). The ::after pseudo-element is positioned at top: 100% (below the card's bottom edge). overflow: hidden clips content outside the element's bounds, so the ::after connector tick is invisible. The analog Styled.Event uses position: relative but does NOT use overflow: hidden (JobApplicationActivity.tsx line 664) — its ::after is visible. The overflow: hidden was added to contain Styled.Bar (the absolutely-positioned gradient strip on the left edge), but it is not a spec requirement. The spec requires the connector tick to be visible.
findings.recommendation: Remove overflow: hidden from Styled.Card. Contain Styled.Bar without clipping: give Styled.Bar border-radius matching the card's left corners (border-top-left-radius and border-bottom-left-radius set to t.poly.radii.md) so it stays within the card visually without needing overflow: hidden. Alternatively, wrap the card content in an inner div with overflow: hidden and keep Styled.Card itself as the unclipped outer element that hosts the ::after.
